# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes go into the latest MacMix release and the `main` branch. If you build from source, update to the latest `main` before reporting.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please don't report security problems in a public issue, discussion or pull request.

- Report privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ljmng7/MacMix/security/advisories/new), or
- email jasmine@jazminli.com.

Please include the MacMix and macOS versions, whether you use the official download or a build from source, the steps to reproduce, and what an attacker could do.

The official app also contains parts that are not in this repository: license activation, the purchase flow and the updater. Problems in those parts can be reported by email in the same way.

I'll confirm that I received your report as soon as I can and keep you updated while I work on a fix.

---

# 安全政策

## 支持的版本

安全修复会进入最新的 MacMix 正式版和 `main` 分支。如果你是自行编译的，请先更新到最新的 `main` 再报告。

## 报告安全漏洞

请不要在公开的 Issue、Discussion 或 Pull Request 中报告安全问题。

- 通过 [GitHub 私密漏洞报告](https://github.com/ljmng7/MacMix/security/advisories/new) 提交，或者
- 发送邮件到 jasmine@jazminli.com。

请写明 MacMix 和 macOS 版本、使用的是官方下载版还是自行编译版、复现步骤，以及攻击者可能利用它做什么。

官方版中还有一些不在本仓库里的部分：许可证激活、购买流程和自动更新。这些部分的问题也可以通过邮件报告。

我会尽快确认收到报告，并在修复期间及时告诉你进展。
